dedupe_keys.name: matlab model for solar powered pump irrigation system sizing and performance analysis

description: Md Muaaz Arshad publishes a MATLAB model for sizing a solar-powered irrigation pumping system. Zenodo lists public hydraulic and photovoltaic calculation scripts, pump-selection and sprinkler-arrangement scripts, a farm-layout CSV, pump specifications and an EPANET network input under CC BY 4.0. These files can support scenario comparisons of pump capacity, solar-array configuration and irrigated network layout. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined pump and irrigation model. Coverage is a sample farm geometry and the named pump specification, not a regional irrigation census. A limitation is that the page has no narrative description of crop demand, solar weather series, hydraulic calibration or runtime order; those settings require code inspection before reuse. EPANET appears as a named file and network input, but compatibility with a particular EPANET version was not established. No MATLAB script or EPANET model was downloaded or run, and energy or pressure outputs were not verified.
